tree.heading: Federal agency.—
tree.text: The term “federal agency” has the same meaning given that term in section 102 of this title.

tree.heading: TTY.—
tree.text: The term “TTY” means a text-telephone used in the transmission of coded signals through the nationwide telecommunications system.
